title: Cosmic Tree Snow Globe
description: A large transparent snow globe sits on a black pedestal in a desert landscape. Inside the globe, a glowing neon tree with swirling galaxy-like spirals grows from a stylized mountain, accompanied by a floating blue bear with pink neon outline. A small white cat sits beside the pedestal.
prompt: A surreal glowing snow globe standing on a black pedestal in a sandy desert at night. Inside the transparent sphere, a vibrant neon tree with branches forming colorful swirling galaxy spirals grows from a stylized mountain. A cute blue bear with white snout and pink neon outline floats beside the tree. A small white cat sits on the ground next to the pedestal. Dreamlike colorful cosmic atmosphere with stars and glowing particles.
